description: Hind digits too low and thin: on the clay each toe is a thick digit whose knuckle top stands about as high as a third of the paw length above the ground and whose width nearly fills the paw, the four digits pressed side by side with tight clefts; on pass 2 they are low narrow pads on a flat sole (knuckle top about a sixth of paw length). The instep is also a vertical step behind the toes where the clay runs one long slope from the metatarsus down over the digits.
